ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram of the food web shown, what role does the human play?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram shows several organisms with labels. On the right side, there is a blue human figure next to the label “Humans–Tertiary consumer/Omnivore.” Reasoning: The question asks what role the human plays in the food web. The adjacent label identifies humans as a tertiary consumer, with omnivore as the feeding type. Therefore, the role is tertiary consumer.
